title: crepidium riparium
intro: Crepidium riparium, commonly known as the Slipper Orchid, is a type of terrestrial orchid that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties that can aid in wound healing and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Crepidium riparium are attributed to its ability to exhibit antioxidant and anti-arthritic activities, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
